faqs.q: Sec. 102-407. - Lead Service Line Replacement Program.
faqs.a:
(a)
The Lead Service Line Replacement Program will go into effect on May 1, 2024.
(b)
The Lead Service Line Replacement Program will delineate applicability, financial
               responsibilities, financing solutions, and any other necessary topics.
(c)
The Lead Service Line Replacement Program details will be publicized by the director
               and be made available on the city's website.
(
Ord. No. 4869
, § 1, 3-4-2024)
